look_here_first: Recognize the tall airy perennial first: wiry arching flowering stems carry white-to-pink four-petaled flowers with the petals held mostly toward the upper side and long exserted stamens hanging/projecting below.

key_traits.text: perennial clump from a stout rootstock

key_traits.text: four petals oriented mainly to one side/upward side of the flower

key_traits.text: flowers in an airy elongate spike/raceme
